summary.text: Wendy Critchlow is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-19 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Critchlow earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont.
Critchlow's career experience includes working as a Medicaid auditor.
